name: Owner's title policy
what: The title insurance policy that protects the buyer's ownership, subject to its exceptions.

fields.label: Policy and file number
fields.definition: The policy number and the title company's file number on Schedule A, used to match the policy to the commitment and the closing.

fields.label: Title insurer and agent
fields.definition: The title insurance company that underwrites the policy, and the title agent that issued it.

fields.label: Amount of insurance
fields.definition: The coverage amount on Schedule A, usually the purchase price; compare it with the commitment.

fields.label: Date of policy
fields.definition: The date and time Schedule A designates as the date of policy.

fields.label: Premium
fields.definition: The premium shown for the policy, to compare with the settlement statement and the rate chart.

fields.label: Name of insured
fields.definition: Who the policy covers; compare it with the grantee on the deed.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-1, Schedule A, item 1

fields.label: Estate insured
fields.definition: The estate or interest in the land the policy covers, such as fee simple, or a leasehold under a named lease.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-1, Schedule A, item 2

fields.label: Title vested in
fields.definition: The owner the policy shows title vested in, which should be the insured.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-1, Schedule A, item 3

fields.label: Legal description
fields.definition: The land the policy covers; compare it word for word with the deed and the survey.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-1, Schedule A, item 4

fields.label: Restrictive covenants
fields.definition: The recorded restrictive covenants excepted, each with recording data, or a note that the exception was deleted.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-1, Schedule B, item 1

fields.label: Area and boundary exception
fields.definition: Whether the printed exception for boundary discrepancies, encroachments and overlapping improvements stands as printed or was amended, and the amended wording if so.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-1, Schedule B, item 2

fields.label: Tax exception year
fields.definition: The tax year named in the exception for standby fees, taxes and assessments.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-1, Schedule B, item 5

fields.label: Specific exceptions
fields.definition: Each matter excepted by name, such as an easement, lease, mineral reservation or recorded agreement, with recording data. Compare the list with the agreed pro forma and the survey.
fields.authority: TDI Form T-1, Schedule B, item 6

fields.label: Endorsements
fields.definition: Each endorsement issued with the policy, by form number and name, with its premium.
